items.title: Arturo O'Farrill interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Tito Puente was still around... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh that’s not a Tito Puente piece.

ctx.x: There was another moment I saw on your Afro-Latin, your large group, “Live at Birdland,” and the first piece you played was by Tito Puente. I’m not sure I could pronounce it, “Iko Iko.”
Oh that’s not a Tito Puente piece.
